# Native platform smoke fixture

Synthetic GameData and StoryJson tables generated from the frozen TS/v2.8.1 unit fixtures by tools/make-fixtures.mjs. Source identities/hashes are recorded in contracts/data-manifest.json under minimal-gamedata-v2. This small fixture is committed so native-platform verification needs no historical JS implementation, live upstream data or local .runtime files. Game/Wiki content terms remain in NOTICE.
